media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The

characters.name: Grim
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: The Grim Reaper, who is fated to be Billy and Mandy's "best friend" forever after losing a limbo contest to them. Abusive Parents:Depending on the Writer; his mom always complains about his lack of enthusiasm for his job and his dad would never talk to him and always listened to country music. Acquainted with Emergency Services: He has this relationship with the nursing staffs at the retirement homes when he comes for the elderly residents, as shown in Season 5 "Home of the Ancients".Gloria: Hi, Grim.Grim: S'up, Gloria?Gloria: Aw. Are you here for Mr. Silverman?Grim: No. That's next week. Affably Evil: Is remarkably polite when he isn't putting his scythe to work or getting bossed around by the title characters. Affectionate Nickname: In the Latin American dub where his name is changed to "Puro Hueso" (pure bone), Billy calls him "Huesitos" (little bones).

characters.name: Billy
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Adim-wittedboy whofrequently causes problemsdue tohis idiocy.Nonetheless, he's usuallythe most innocent and happy-go-lucky of the trio.He is Mandy's best friend. Absurd Phobia: In "Billy and Mandy's Big Boogey Adventure", Billy is shown to be not only afraid of spiders and clowns, butthe mailmanas well. Abusive Parents: Bizarrely, he's verbally and outrightphysically abusivetowards his own son, Jeff the Spider. (Semi-justified in that Billy is extremely stupid and has an irrational fear of spiders.) Hefrequently tries every method possible to kill him, including sending an exterminator to crush him beneath a huge cowboy boot, throwing furniture onto him, and cutting the brake cables in his car.Jeff:(as Billy is jabbing him in the eyes with a broomstick)Why won't you love me, Dad?! I'll be anything you want me to be!Billy:IWANT YOUTO BEDEAD! Acquainted with Emergency Services: In Season 2 "Educating Grim", when Billy tries to race Grim and Mandy to school, he immediately runs into the school's front sign. Cue Nurse Penbroke walking outside holding first-aid kits looking annoyed. After Billy and Mandy leave school, Billy is already covered in bandages and walking with a crutch. When Nurse Penbrokehappilywaits outside for Billy, he tells her he's done for today and then she releases an exhausted sigh.Nurse Penbroke: Oh, Billy.Billy:(cheerfully)Hi, Nurse Penbroke. I can't feel my legs. Action Survivor: He's an adolescent boy with no real powers, but often escapes problems with his life. Usually. This is much more prominent earlier on in the show than later.

characters.name: Mandy
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Billy's best friend and his polar opposite; a merciless,cynicalandmanipulative little girlwho frequently abuses Grim's power to get what she wants. Shealmost never smilesand terrifies almost everyone around her, her parents included. Unlike Billy, she's stable, sane, andintelligent. Absurd Phobia: According to Billy and Grim, she's afraid offigure skaters, of all things. Mandy denies this, but is visibly flustered by the topic andmentions that she doesn't trust the way they spin. Abusive Offspring: She's just as rude and demanding to her parents as she is to everyone else; they readily bow down to her, do whatever she wants without question, and openly admit in "Keeper of the Reaper" that they're terrified of her. In a twist on this though, she's genuinely shocked at this revelation,strongly implying that she never intended to frighten them like that. The Ace: She's hypercompetent at pretty much everything and has almost the entire universe groveling at her feet. It makes her plans for world domination all the more terrifying due to howplausiblethey are. Action Girl: She's the most consistently competent in a fight out of the three of them.

characters.name: Harold
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Billy's father and Gladys' husband. Absurd Phobia:Attack of the Clownsimplies that he has a fear of Santa Claus. Though considering Santa's been turned into a vampire about seven times in the past, chances are Harold's phobia might not be that absurd. Abusive Parents:Surprisingly, depending on the episode, he qualifies as this much more than his wife. Because of his lack of any maturity or intelligence, he's often incapable of behaving anywhere close to a proper parent and is more like his equal mentally. He is capable of childishly mocking his son, for playing with the dinosaur toys inToys Will Be Toysand is even dense enough to bully his son and ask for his lunch money inThe Crass Unicorn. He was even willing to beat up someone he thought was his son for cutting his pompadour off.His own father comes across as this in the flashback in "Billy Idiot", disapproving of Harold’s love of ballet, even going so far as to yelling "Dancing is for girls!" during Harold’s dance recital just when he was about to attempt the Mabuhay Shuffle, throwing him off balance and publicly humiliating him. Surprisingly, depending on the episode, he qualifies as this much more than his wife. Because of his lack of any maturity or intelligence, he's often incapable of behaving anywhere close to a proper parent and is more like his equal mentally. He is capable of childishly mocking his son, for playing with the dinosaur toys inToys Will Be Toysand is even dense enough to bully his son and ask for his lunch money inThe Crass Unicorn. He was even willing to beat up someone he thought was his son for cutting his pompadour off. His own father comes across as this in the flashback in "Billy Idiot", disapproving of Harold’s love of ballet, even going so far as to yelling "Dancing is for girls!" during Harold’s dance recital just when he was about to attempt the Mabuhay Shuffle, throwing him off balance and publicly humiliating him.

characters.name: Gladys
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Billy's mother and Harold's wife. Anger Born of Worry: Her angry side was born from her worry of Grim, and she learned to not fear him, but destroy him. Ax-Crazy: At times she solves problems in an unnecessarily violent way, like when she mistook a hairy Billy for a sasquatch and tried to kill him. Doting Parent: She is a caring but overprotective mother to Billy. Double Standard: Abuse, Female on Male: In many episodes, Gladys will threaten and even hit Harold. In "Scary Poppins", Harold is even indicated to be terrified of Gladys.

characters.name: Aunt Sis
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Harold's sister and Billy's aunt, who later marries and starts a family with Nergal at the center of the Earth. Admiring the Abomination: She falls in love with Nergal. Ascended Extra: She first appeared at the end of the episode with Grim's first encounter with Gladys, taking her away from home, only to later had her own focus episode and later marrying Nergal. The Cameo: She is briefly seen on a picnic with her husband and son inUnderfist. Everyone Calls Him "Barkeep": Assuming that "Sis" is just a nickname, we never find out what her real name is — she's named by her relation to Billy and his family (she's Harold's sister, making her Billy's aunt).

characters.name: Billy’s Grandpa
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Billy’s paternal grandfather. Abusive Parents: Insulted his son’s passions. That said, his relationship with his grandson isn’t touched, so it’s not clear whether he’s aGruesome Grandparent. He-Man Woman Hater:Implied, given that he told his son that dancing was only for girls. Strong Family Resemblance: He’s basically an older Billy with something of an Irish/Scottish accent. What the Hell Is That Accent?: Speaks with a vaguely Irish/Scottish accent.

characters.name: Mandy's Parents
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Mandy's parents. They are utterly terrified of her. A Day in the Limelight: "Scary Poppins" explores their relationship with Mandy. Depending on the Writer: Whether they're seemingly oblivious of Mandy's cruelty or completely terrified of her tends to vary from episode to episode. The rare episodes that give them a decent amount of focus tend to stick to the latter. Good Parents: For the most part. They love and take care of Mandy despite the horrible treatment they receive. Hippie Parents: They seem to beBeatniks, hence why they're so okay with Mandy's abuse.

characters.name: Irwin
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: A nerdy boy and a close friend of Billy's. He has a one-sided crush on Mandy. Later revealed to have monstrous heritage and becomes a crucial member of Underfist. Abhorrent Admirer: Mandy can't stand his infatuation. All of the occasions of her reciprocating his feelings or at least not responding to his advances with a punch were either due to magical influence orbeing unconscious. Accidental Hero: Him unintentionally suffering all of Mandy's pranks that were meant for Jack in the Halloween special is what ultimately leads to Jack being defeated. All Girls Want Bad Boys:Gender Inverted, he has a major crush on the surly, aggressive, snarky and intimidatingMandy. The episode, "Heartburn", confirms that this is the reason he likes her so much. Beware the Silly Ones: And theNice Onesat that. Irwin may be a meek geek who’s the residentButt-Monkeyof the series, butUnderfistshows that he's actuallyfarmore powerful than he seems due to being 1/4 vampire and 1/2 mummy, once his vampire-mummy powers manifest.

characters.name: Mindy
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: An obnoxious and snobby girl from Billy and Mandy's school that is obsessed with proving her worth to Mandy, who doesn't care for her. Alpha Bitch: A deconstructed one as avery dim-witted, insecure, andneurotictype. And in theUnderfistspecial she loses the alpha grade because of losing her looks which ups her bitchiness to supervillain take-over-the-world levels to regain it. Asshole Victim: Thankfully, she's also one of the show's regular victims of whatever supernatural power is at hand in the episode. Bratty Half-Pint: She's definitely a rude and insufferable kid. Bullying a Dragon: Picking on Mandy is not a very wise thing to do considering her ungodly amounts of hypercompetence, extreme intelligence and sociopathic tendencies, but for some reason Mindy sees her as no threat.

characters.name: Pud'n
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: A classmate of Billy and Mandy's, Pud'n is a very sensitive young boy who is constantly picked on by Sperg. Beware the Nice Ones: He got into an epic struggle with a demon rabbit and causes an explosion by squirting the custard out of two éclairs (though he took quite a beating from the rabbit), and he once viciously beat up General Skarr when he thought Skarr was responsible for turning all his neighborhood rabbit friends into monsters (it was actually Grim who did it). Brown Bag Mask: He wears one while competing in a go-kart race with the other kids. He miraculously wins, despite his go-kart being nothing more than a simple red wagon. Mandy ends up unmasking him, and he starts crying like a baby when he sees everyone cheering for him. Butt-Monkey: It's very common for him to get hurt or humiliated and arguably Irwin is the only one who gets it as bad as he does. Deconstructed Character Archetype: Of the idea of aButt-Monkey. By all accounts, Pud'n is a genuinely good person at heart and while other characters of his type are given varying degrees of negative or annoying traits and habits to keep their suffering as feeling fair, Pud'n's biggest crimes are being easily overwhelmed and a bit juvenile. If he gets madit's for a damn good reason,he is surprisingly anAction Survivorin this world, and him being treated like dirt by others is more reflective of how stupid and meantheyare. A good showcase of this is when Pud'n enters a race in his wagon and a mask - everyone in the crowd laughs at him but the camera focuses on them for the comedy and shifts to adonkeysitting in the bleachers,twice. Cut to the end, wherePud'n inexplicably wins and is carried away by the cheering crowd(albeit crying).

characters.name: Sperg
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: The local (and dumb) bully who constantly bullies Billy, Irwin, Pud'n, and other kids to no end. Asshole Victim: In "The Nerve", whenever he is assaulted by Billy, he still lacks redeeming qualities no less. Berserk Button: Don't talk bad about his mom... or good about his mom either, especially if it causes her to cry right in front of him. The Bully: He is often seen tormenting Billy, Irwin, or other kids. Disappeared Dad: His mom only shows up a few times, but we never see his dad.

characters.name: Ms. Butterbean
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: The teacher of Billy and Mandy's class in Endsville Elementary. She is very apathetic towards teaching, only doing her job for a paycheck and is often seen sleeping in class. And Now You Must Marry Me: She gets kidnapped by Fred Flintstone in "Modern Primitves", which causes her to demand that he marry her and give her 2.5 kids. Apathetic Teacher: Doesn't give a lick about her job and she is often seen snoring on her desk. And that's her on her good days.Granted, given justhow utterly bonkers the world is around her, the quality of the kids she has to teach, and (given what the Principal gives Grim when he becomes a substitute teacher in "Detention X") the downrightabysmalpay being at minimumtwo dollarsan hour, it's not without reason. Asshole Victim: In "Substitute Teacher" she lets Sperg bully Nergal Junior. Nobody feels sorry for her when Junior kidnaps her and ties her to the ceiling. Thankfully this happens very often... Butt-Monkey: Comes with the territory of being around Billy and not cautious and also suffering because of various supernatural phenomena but not an undeserving one satisfyingly enough.

characters.name: Principal Goodvibes
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: The principal of Endsville Elementary, and kind of a wuss. Beware the Nice Ones: When sufficiently angry, not evenMandycan stand up to him. Big Good: Subverted. He's the principal of the school which is one of the show's major settings, but he's such a meek wimp that even with his position he is usually of no help to the heroes. Butt-Monkey: Yet another character on the show who tends to suffer misfortunes on a frequent basis. Characterization Marches On: His very first appearance depicts him as reasonably self assured and assertive despite his meek demeanor, properly holding Sperg accountable for his bullying and getting livid enough tomake Mandy submit. This aspect of him is dropped immediately afterwards and he's portrayed as pathetic and powerless, also leaving him just as much (if not moreso) at the mercy of theCrapsack Worldthat is the show as everyone else.

characters.name: Hoss Delgado
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: A spectral exterminator who frequently encounters Grim, Billy, and Mandy in his various exploits, and briefly dates Eris, Goddess of Chaos. Later becomes part of the Underfist team, albeit reluctantly at first. Accidental Misnaming: He can't ever remember Irwin's name. InUnderfistalone, he calls him "Irving", "Urkel" and "Ivan".He correctly calls him "Irwin" while saving him from the giant pumpkin-headed candy monster... only to go back to forgetting his name a short while afterwards.In "Guess What's Coming To Dinner", he also can't remember the names of either Billy or Principal Goodvibes. Anti-Hero: He believes that all monsters are a threat, which causes him to murder any monster he ever sees, even innocent and harmless ones. Art Evolution:He's noticeably older looking inUnderfist, sporting a beer gut and streaks of grey in his hair. He's also even larger than before and has a chainsaw leg.Before that, his head became more angular following the show being split off fromGrim & Evil. He's noticeably older looking inUnderfist, sporting a beer gut and streaks of grey in his hair. He's also even larger than before and has a chainsaw leg.

characters.name: Dick
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Irwin's dad and Tanya's son. He's friends with Harold, and it's revealed he's Dracula's son as well. Black and Nerdy: Like his son, he's a black geek. Boy Meets Ghoul: He married and had a child with an undead mummy. Dhampyr: As Dracula is his father, he's half-vampire, though unlike Irwin he never exhibits supernatural traits. Generation Xerox: Like his mother, he married a supernatural being. Worked out better for him, though.

characters.name: Tanya
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Irwin's paternal grandmother, more commonly known as "Grandmama." Amazingly Embarrassing Parents: The short "Hate in an Elevator" had her become an amazingly embarrassinggrandparent by telling humiliating stories about her grandson to Mandy while the three of them were stuck in an elevator. Once they're free, she continues to embarrass her grandson by telling the stories to the news crew that interviews them about their time stuck in the elevator. Badass Normal: She's only human, yet she went toe-to-toe against Goodbling andmanaged to tame her husband Dracula. Cool Old Lady: Unlike many of the adults on the show, she's more competent. You qualify as this if you're able to getDracula, your husbandto shut up and just eat their dinner. Curb-Stomp Battle: Delivered a one-sided beating to Principal Goodbling in the form of"yo-mama"jokes.

characters.name: Malaria
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: AGothwoman who was briefly Grim's girlfriend. Advertised Extra: Although Malaria appears in the show’s intro, her role in the series amounts to a major role in justoneepisode ("Grim in Love") and asilent cameoin another ("The Incredible Shrinking Mandy"). The Cameo: She has one in "The Incredible Shrinking Mandy" as one of Billy's attempts to cheer Grim up. But Grim seems to have gotten completely over her at this point since he doesn't even react. Death and the Maiden: She falls in love with Grim in the aptly named episode "Grim in Love". She shares his sadistic sense of humor and they both enjoy each other's company. By the end, he reveals to her that he is the real Grim Reaper and that all of his friends are actual monsters, leading her to run away in sheer terror. Early-Bird Cameo: She appears amongst the other side characters in the show's opening theme.

characters.name: Ernest
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Skarr’s neighbour after moving to Endsville. Cloudcuckoolander: He’s fairly off. His first scene has him seemingly go mad and suddenly switch to affability. Cool Old Guy: Despite his eccentric personality, he seems like a pretty decent person to be around, so long as you don't ask him to watch your house because he fully admits he isn't very reliable. Large Ham: Oh yes. His very first scene is screaming a bunch of warnings. Though it’s no surprise given that he’s voiced byHowling Mad Murdockhimself,Dwight Schultz. Men Can't Keep House: Despite only watching Skarr's house for a few days, he leaves it and the yard a mess that gives it the impression that Skarr had become a crazed shut in - and when Skarr calls him out on it Ernest admits that he isn't very reliable.

characters.name: Mrs. Doolin
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: The old lady living in a house that Billy and Irwin are are afraid to go in. Berserk Button: Sexism. When she finds out what Billy and Irwin told Mandy, she happily agrees to help Mandy. Cool Old Lady: In trueBetty Whitefashion, she’s portrayed as a kind woman. Dead All Along:The ending of "Who Killed Who?" reveals that she's actually a ghost who has haunted her (in reality) abandoned, dilapidated mansion for decades, never having moved on to the afterlife due to her always besting Grim at practicallyeverything. In other words, she beatDeath itself, and thus lives on as a spirit for eternity. Sheep in Sheep's Clothing: It appears at first she has malevolent intentions, but it turns out she’s a genuinely kind woman.

characters.name: Nanny
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: A famous television icon who's sent to rehabilitate Mandy. Abhorrent Admirer: She thinks that Grim is just trying to hit on her at one point and eagerly flirts with him, causing him to aggressively vomit in disgust. Anti-Villain: Although she’s an antagonist from Mandy’s point of view, she’s just doing her job in trying to reform what she thinks is simply a spoiled rotten child. Asshole Victim: In spades. Despite trying to do her job, she's rude and nasty towards everyone, not just Mandy. It doesn't quite make her violent death deserved, but she did need some form of comeuppance. Bullying a Dragon: She finds out the hard way Mandy isn't someone you mess around with, though she never could’ve had any idea the girl was a purely evil sociopath who somehow mentally controlled the rest of humanity.

characters.name: Exercise Dude
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: ARichard Simmons-esque trainer Billy uses to awaken Mandy. Determinator: He was so determined to get the cake from Grim, that he stole a random guy's bike to catch up to him. He even cuts a slice of cake in his final moments before sinking into the ocean. Large Ham: Why Billy used him to awaken Mandy. No Celebrities Were Harmed: Is blatantly based offRichard Simmons. Atoms has even said that Simmons was the original choice to voice him. Shout-Out: His chase and "end" is an obvious homage toThe Terminator.

characters.name: Eris
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: The goddess of chaos. She possesses the powerful Apple of Discord, a golden apple that can transform into any shape to perpetuate chaos. Grim used to have a crush on her during earlier episodes but later changed his mind, claiming her to be a "psychopath". She is also in love with Hoss Delgado, who reciprocates but finds her to be too dangerous. Accent Slip-Up: Occasionally, she'll slip out of a British accent into a standard American one whenever she gets surprised. Alpha Bitch: Gave off the vibe of being stuck-up and rude in her debut episode. Art Evolution: Her design constantly changes with every appearance she makes. Artifact of Doom: The Apple of Discord, a golden apple that can transform into any shape to perpetuate chaos (though Billy calls it a "magic banana").

characters.name: The Boogeyman
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: An old rival/enemy of Grim's since middle school as well as a former school bully, Boogey played pranks on Grim throughout his school career. Boogey is, in fact, the Boogeyman himself, and can shapeshift in order to scare people. Unfortunately, though, he is completely unable to scare kids because they have become desensitized by modern media. Amoral Attorney: He's the prosecuting attorney against Grim during his trial inBig Boogey Adventure. Arson, Murder, and Jaywalking: He blames his inability to scare children on TV, video games, and thetuba. Big Bad: He is the main villain in "Billy and Mandy's Big Boogey Adventure" (interviews with Maxwell stated thatWrath of Khanwas what inspired him to use him since he appeared in only one episode). He was also indirectly responsible for the events in "Wrath of the Spider Queen". Karmic Butt-Monkey: His first appearance shows that only exceptionally wimpy and cowardly children are afraid of him, as he gets frightened by seeing a teenager with a face full of zits and piercings, fails to scare Billy with aJump Scarefrom a TV, and instead finds himself getting tormented by Billy fast-forwarding and rewinding, causing him to go in and out of the TV. His scare-off with Grim is also a complete and utterCurb-Stomp Battle, as the kid he tries to scare thinks he's a cute puppy when he turns into a werewolf, while Grim effortlessly wins.He also suffers misfortunes as theBig Badof "Billy and Mandy's Big Boogey Adventure" and he isn't even treated seriously when he's not suffering.Also at the end, he suffers an epic string of misfortunes and slapstick humor.

characters.name: Nergal
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: TheMesopotamian god of war, pestilence, and destructionwho rules the underworld with an iron fist. He has the ability to shapeshift, with which he can create several tentacles from his back that can electrocute his victims or turn them into beings looking like himself.What Nergal desires most is having friends, once stating that it is quite lonely in the center of the world. However, he gets better once he starts a family. Affably Evil: He's generally polite, even around his victims. Anti-Villain: He merely wants friends and doesn't understand how to achieve it, while still respecting their wishes and limits. When he feels accepted he is pretty nice. The Bad Guy Wins: He comes out on top in "Something Stupid This Way Comes" and "Love Is Evol Spelled Backwards". The former has him converting all of Endsville into Nergalings (though it doesn’t stick). The latter has him winning Aunt Sis's affection and marrying her, though this isn't portrayed as a bad thing. Big Bad: Despite this being played straight in his first few appearances, this is solely Played for Laughs in most of his later appearances. Even though he is considered the trio's arch-nemesis, and Grim and Mandy consider him "lower than low", most of his appearances just boil down to him just being there hurting nobody, acting as aButt-Monkey, or getting in some petty rivalry with Grim, espesically in "Nergal's Pizza".

characters.name: Nergal Junior
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: The son of Nergal and Billy's aunt Sis. As a result, he is Billy's first cousin. Ancestral Name: His father's name is also Nergal. Ascended Extra: He became a recurring character thanks to being in the same school as Billy and Mandy, and would be the protagonist of his own episodes, moreso than his father. From a meta point of view, is justified, as Nergal Jr was more relatable to the audience than his father was. Berserk Button: Donotcall him a freak or say he's hideous. Seriously, just don't. Brainy Baby: He was already speaking full sentences as anegg. It's kind of easy to forget the fact that he's technically an infant, considering he spends much of his time in the guise of a tween boy.

characters.name: Jeff the Spider
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: A man-sized spider that Billy hatched from an egg that quickly imprinted on Billy. Later tried to "grow up", with mixed results, and joined Underfist. Beware the Nice Ones: As seen in "Spider's Little Daddy", and to a lesser extentUnderfist. Casting Gag: Jeff is voiced by series creator Maxwell Atoms, who initially voiced Billy in theBilly and Mandy in: Trepanation of the Skull and Youvideo under his real name Adam Burton. Atoms here voices Jeff, Billy's "son", ironic as Billy is his creation. Crouching Moron, Hidden Badass: He's incredibly friendly but also, as Mandy accurately describes him, "basically insane", due to his inability to recognize that Billy is terrified of him due to Jeff being a giant spider as well as his inability to even be assertive or mean at all. Despite this, he's a surprisingly competent pilot and driver, as revealed inUnderfist. Friendly Neighborhood Spider: He's an overwhelmingly nice, gigantic spider.

characters.name: Fred Fredburger
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: A dimwitted, pale green, bipedal furry otherworldly creature resembling an elephant with stubby horns and the tail of a devil. Ends up forming Underfist just via a drawing. Advertised Extra: Despite being heavily promoted in bumpers and being the mascot of Cartoon Network for a while, Fred only appears in Season Five and two episodes at that. He also appeared inBig Boogey Adventure.He is part of the main cast inUnderfist, which was an attempt to rectify this, but ultimately failed as the series was not picked up. Alliterative Name: His first and last name both being with the letter F. Big Eater: He's obsessed with food, especially frozen yogurt and nachos. Blush Sticker: He has two pink blushes on each side of his cheeks making him more cute.

characters.name: Dracula
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: A vampire that was Grim's childhood hero. Adaptational Friendship: In his younger years, him and Van Helsing were best friends. Adaptational Heroism: He may not be the nicest guy ever, but he's still a far better person than the original novel character. Berserk Button: Calling him old sends him into a frenzy. Breakout Character: Introduced as part of the old horror icons alongside the Wolfman and the Bride of Frankenstein in "Home of the Ancients". But thanks to Phil hitting the role so enthusiastically, he made more appearances, completely eclipsing the Bride and Wolfman, even having afamily connection to Irwin. He was even used for part of Cartoon Network's live-action Halloween promos via a puppet.

characters.name: Judge Roy Spleen
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Butt-Monkey: He constantly deals with Fred Fredburger's stupidity to the point of losing his sanity, even "allowing" him to take as much time as he needs in the bathroom, simply as an excuse to get rid of him. The Comically Serious: Despite his no-nonsense demeanor, he has a couple of funny moments, like at the beginning of the "Keeper of the Reaper" where he thinks he's officiating a wedding and upon being corrected by the Fly Bailiff, he calls him the Judge before being corrected yet again. Cool and Unusual Punishment: In "Keeper of the Reaper" when Billy and Mandy start bickering, he threatens to make them sit in the chocolate pudding chair. While this may seem like a harmless threat, he states that there will be permanent stains on their clothes. Weirdly enough, this manages to get them (Mandy included) to be put in line. Judicial Wig: As customary for Judges, he wears a white, curly, and fairly long wig. Stern Old Judge: He's very no-nonsense and does not tolerate any tomfoolery whatsoever. It's a shame that he met Fred Fredburger.

characters.name: Lord Pain
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Grim's (former) destructive servant. He'sunfailingly loyalto whoever he considers his "master", as shown with Grim and later Mandy. Badass Cape: He wears a black cape with a high collar. Carry a Big Stick: His main weapon is a large, spiky mace. Cowboy: One of his alternate costumes in the video game is a garish cowboy outfit. Early-Bird Cameo: Appears in the theme song despite being a Season 3 debut, the show splitting off in Season 2.

characters.name: Nigel Planter
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Alegally distinct magically-inclined boywho resides in Weaselthorpe House at Toadblatt's School of Sorcery. Arch-Nemesis: Lord Moldybuttnote*CRASH!*WOULD be his mortal foeexcept forthe fact that he's a real estate attorney. Casanova Wannabe: Uses incredibly cheesy pickup lines when flirting with Mandy, and later does the same with Herfefiny. The Chosen One: The wizard destined to defeat Lord Moldybuttnote*CRASH!*.In actuality, he's destined to become the CEO of Peanuts by Planter, and has no future as a wizard. Corrupted Character Copy: OfHarry Potter. Unlike Harry, who is relatively humble and fairly skilled as a wizard, Nigel has an enormous ego and is completely hopeless at magic.He's eventually revealed to have close to no potential as a wizard at all because heisn'tone: he's the heir to a peanut conglomerate.

characters.name: Dean Toadblatt
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: The dean of Toadblatt's School of Sorcery. Actor Allusion: His whole character in a nutshell is "What ifDean Wormerwas in charge ofHogwarts?" But for Me, It Was Tuesday: When Nigel Planter tries to get even with him in his last appearance, he doesn't remember him. When asked about this, Toadblatt explains that he's tormented thousands of students every semester and can't be expected to remember all of them. Composite Character: As the head honcho in charge of a boarding school for wizards, he fills the same role as Albus Dumbledore fromHarry Potter; however, his personality as aDean Bittermanwith an obsessive grudge against one of the fraternities —on top of being played by John Vernon— brings to mind Dean Vernon Wormer fromAnimal House. Dean Bitterman: He's your standard ill-tempered dean who has it in for (almost) everyone at the school. Bonus for being voiced by the actor forthemost popular example of this trope,John Vernon.

characters.name: Lord Moldybutt
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: A creepy man who's after Nigel Planter. Dub Name Change: In the Latin American Spanish version, he's called Lord Valdomero.note*¡PLAF!* Expy: A blatant pastiche of Voldemort from theHarry Potterbooks, even down to people not wanting to say his full name. Though a lot less efficentnoteThough in the books, this was because of Voldemort being so reviled, while Moldybutt's [*CRASH!*] name just causes things to break for no reason.As mentioned below, he actually isn't even a bad guy.. Good All Along:He's actually just trying to hand over Nigel Planter's inheritance to him. Real After All: "Nigel Planter and the Chamber Pot of Secrets" ended with Lord Moldybuttnote*CRASH!*at first appearing to really bea disguised Dean Toadblatt, but the very end of the episode shows that he actually does exist.

characters.name: Sir Raven
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: A raven that occasionally narrates episodes. Chewing the Scenery: He has a tendency to randomly BURST OUT IN SHOUTING! LIKE! THIIIIIIIIIIS! Creepy Crows: Well, duh. Deadpan Snarker: A very LOUD snarker, too. Greek Chorus: His role is to comment on the story as it's going on.

characters.name: Judy
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Dick’s wife and Irwin’s Mother, who just so happens to be aMummy. She’s the estranged daughter of King Poppin' Lockin', an ancient Egyptian pharaoh. Boy Meets Ghoul: She fell in love and married Dick sometime before the events of the series. Calling the Old Man Out: She hated how her father treated their subjects so cruelly, which ultimately resulted in her leaving home and never speaking to him again. In the present day, she was furious when he manipulated her son, Irwin, into building a pyramid and ruling Endsville, and rightfully called him out on it. Chummy Mummy: Despite being a mummy, she's actually very nice and is also a loving and devoted wife and mother. Happily Married: To Dick.

characters.name: Grim’s Parents
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Grim's emotionally abusive parents. Abusive Parents: Grim's mother regularly hits him while his father outright tells himthat he prefers country music over his child. Depending on the Writer: Did they want their son to be the Grim Reaper?A Grim Prophecyshowed that they wanted him to be the Grim Reaper whileDad Day Afternoonpoints to no. Expy: Grim's dad is a clear parody ofRed Forman, right down to being played byKurtwood Smith, though he does shows traces of being one toMr. Perry, whom Smith also played. Parental Neglect: Grim's father ignored him in favour of country music. In fact, when Grim tried to become a country rocker, he listened to the music than him.

characters.name: Pinocchio
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: An animated wooden puppet who wants to become a real boy. He has some... unorthodox ideas about how he can accomplish his goal. Accidental Misnaming: Billy consistenly mispronounces his name, generally jamming a bunch of extra syllables or outright gibberish into the middle. Adaptational Villainy: Even at his worst, Pinocchio in the original novel never sought to consume human flesh like he does here. Ambiguous Situation: When Pinocchio first appears in the episode "Nursery Crimes", he's just a character in a book of fairy tales into which Billy and Mandy have been transported by Grim. When he reappears a few seasons later in "Billy Ocean", he's now present in the real world, has recovered from Mandy turning him into a chair, and is stuck inside a whale with Geppetto. It's unclear how, when, or why this happened. Become a Real Boy: As with the other versions of Pinocchio, he wants to become a real boy. However, the method he hits upon to achieve his goal is a little nastier.

characters.name: Harvey
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Crusading Lawyer: Is Grim's lawyer and seems to have his best interests in mind. Early Installment Character-Design Difference: Had pink skin in his first episode, but orange for the other two he appeared in. No Celebrities Were Harmed: Sounds likeChristopher Walken. Snake People: He resembles a snake with human-like arms.

characters.name: Jack O'Lantern
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: The main antagonist in the Halloween special, "Billy & Mandy's Jacked Up Halloween". Originally a mortal from the middle ages of Endsville, Jack was the town's prankster who liked playing tricks on the citizens until they got fed up with Jack's antics and gave him a taste of his own medicine by giving the Queen (who had no sense of humor) a trick that came from Jack, which caused her to execute him in retaliation. Grim was supposed to take him to the underworld after being killed, but Jack refused and after tickling Grim and taking his scythe, Jack bargained with Grim to live forever so he could play pranks for eternity. After granting Jack eternal life however, Grim decided to cut his head off as he didn't liked being tricked. Because of that, Jack had to wear a pumpkin as his new head and was shunned by the changing world. As such, he only plays tricks on Halloween night as revenge on the people of Endsville for what happened to him. He would later get his hands on Grim's scythe thanks to Billy bragging that he's holding the real thing, which he used to unleash hell onto Endsville. Advertised Extra: Although Jack appears in the show’s intro, heonlyappears in "Billy and Mandy's Jacked-Up Halloween" and gets a brief mention inBig Boogey Adventure. Be Careful What You Wish For: He wanted eternal life so that he could continue playing tricks on the people of Endsville forever. He got his wish and is subsequently forced to remain isolated in his cottage for eternity after Grim decapitates him as punishment for tricking him, only able to leave once a year on Halloween to pull his tricks (and do things like go grocery shopping).

characters.name: Brain-Eating Meteor
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: A strange alien meteorite that arrives in Endsville in,Little Rock of Horrors. His goal is to devour the brains of everyone he finds and enlists Billy (who is brainless) to bring him fresh victims. Aside Glance: Briefly gives an annoyed half-lidded look towards the audience when his first attempts to get Billy to bring him brains nets him a box of half-eaten "Bran" cereal. Asshole Victim: His defeat definitely cements him as this. Assimilation Backfire: What ultimately does him in when he eats Mandy's brain. In her own words, her brain turned out to be a bit too "spicy" for him to handle. Astonishingly Appropriate Appearance: His main body looks like a brain, reflecting the fact that brains are hisTrademark Favorite Food.

characters.name: Velma Green, The Spider Queen
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: A spider-woman who holds a grudge against Grim for winning the title of Reaper instead of her. Cute Monster Girl: She is definitely one of the most attractive monsters in the series. She played this trope straighter as a teenager as she had a very nerdy appearance and a slightly dorky personality. Disc-One Final Boss: She is set up as the main antagonist of "Wrath of the Spider Queen" before Arachnotaur is revealed to be the real threat. Eerie Pale-Skinned Brunette: She's a sinister person with dark hair and pale skin. Hive Queen: She can control all spiders.

characters.name: Arachnotaur, Spider God of Anger
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: The Spider God of Anger, who appears as a minotaur with the legs and abdomen of a spider. Big Bad: He turns out to have beenthe one manipulating the conflictin "Wrath of the Spider Queen" by exacerbating Jeff and Velma's anger. No-Holds-Barred Beatdown: Gives one to Billy at the climax of "Wrath of The Spider Queen" Sealed Evil in a Can: He was imprisoned in a carton of chocolate milk before Billy freed him.

characters.name: Bun-Bun
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: An evil marshmallow bunny who is the main antagonist ofUnderfist. Big Bad: He is the main villain ofUnderfist. Black Bead Eyes: He has black dots for eyes, just like Billy and Harold. The Chessmaster:He secretly turned Mindy into a witch, lied to her that Irwin is the one to blame for it, and convinced her to help him with his evil plan with her new magical powers. He also had Mindy trick Irwin into touching one of his magic emeralds so he could power all his emeralds with Irwin’s mummy-vampire powers and use them to create portals from the Underworld to Endsville. Deadpan Snarker: He sarcastically goes into a spiel about the "Grammar Police" when Irwin tries to correct his grammar.

characters.name: Ms. Pollywinkle
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: A dance teacher who quite unwillingly turns out to be a malevolent witch. Accidental Misnaming: Billy does this to her a few times, noticeably calling herMolly Ringwaldonce. She even mistakes her own name. Big Bad: Of the episode "Billy Idiot". Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: She initially presents herself as a nice and amiable person before ultimately turning out to be vicious, scheming, slimy, conniving, and manipulative. Card-Carrying Villain: When Harold proclaims she can't have Billy's soul because it wasn't in the school curriculum, Pollywinkle points out they advertised it on the front page of the brochure in bright red letters.

characters.name: Billy and Mandy's Shadows
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Mandy's sentient shadow, who's far nicer than her. Beware the Nice Ones: Don't you dare to snap in front of her. Break the Cutie: When your shadow is Mandy, you know this’ll happen. Cloudcuckoolander: Very much so! Cuckoosnarker: Just like the original, she isn't devoid of snarking.

characters.name: Horror the Ancient
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Horror is a large statue warrior that guards the Left Hand of Horror on the Isle of Peril. In the past, Horror was once a very fearful person and decided to magically channel all his fears into his left hand and cut it off so he would be forever brave. His dismembered left hand soon became Horror’s Hand. Didn't Think This Through: He reveals that he just about immediately regretted cutting off his left hand due to it not making him truly brave like thought, and the fact that he was a lefty, so now he couldn’t even sign his own name. Hidden Depths: He’s self-taught in the art of playing guitar with his teeth. In the"Where Are They Now?" Epiloguein "Billy and Mandy’s Big Boogey Adventure", it’s shown that he became a rock god with this talent. Living Statue: He’s a giant sentient wooden statue. Names to Run Away from Really Fast: He’s known asHorror the Ancient. But it's ultimately subverted because once we actually meet him, he turns out to be fairly friendly and polite.

characters.name: Santa Claus
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: The jolly old man himself, and the antagonist for most ofBilly and Mandy Save Christmas. When the trio meet him, he's unfortunately not as jolly and full of Christmas Cheer as the books describe him, thanks to a nasty case of vampirism. It's up to Billy, Mandy, and Grim to restore him to his normal self, lest Christmas be ruined forever. Ambiguously Human: As with most media depicting the jolly old fat man, it's not clear if Santa is human, a metahuman, or a spirit exactly, and the show's canon never states if he's human either.Though the fact that he can be turned into a vampire indicates he is at least vulnerable to vampirization. Aw, Look! They Really Do Love Each Other: Despite the fact thatMrs. Claus is literally avampirethat turned him after he ignored her too much,he really does love his wife, despite everything. Crazy-Prepared: He actually has a contingency recording to direct any possible victims of his vampiric rampage on making a remedy, one that is apparently so simple that evenBillyhas no issue following it.He eventually reveals to Mandy that the events in theChristmas Specialare "the sixth or seventh time" that Nancy has turned him into a vampire. Heel Realization: Thanks to Billy, of all people,he realizes that his focus on Christmas work has left Mrs. Claus feeling unappreciated and overburdened and reconciles with her.

characters.name: Creeper
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Appearing only inBig Boogey Adventure, Creeper is Boogey's reluctant right-hand man who is clearly saner and more intelligent than his boss and makes no secret of this. Beleaguered Assistant: It's clear that he does not enjoy his role as Boogey's subordinate. Cut Lex Luthor a Check:The"Where Are They Now?" Epiloguereveals that he eventually patented his time travel technology and got filthy rich from it. The Dragon: He's the right-hand man to Boogey in the main story, and acts this way to the Lord of Horror in theBad Future. Dragon Ascendant:Once Boogey is out of the picture, Creeper wastes no time establishing himself as the new Captain of the Boogey Bay.

characters.name: Morg
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Arson, Murder, and Jaywalking: He had Grim Reapers from other planets like the Venus reaper disintegrated for failing to cooperate, the Mercury reaper vaporized for attempting to flee, and the Uranus reaper terminated for poor personal hygiene. Aliens Are Bastards: He is the ruler of mars and seeks to conquer earth using a mind controlled zombified army. Big Bad: He is the main villain of Billy & Mandy vs. the Martians. Evil Overlord: In addition to being a Grim Reaper he is also the Emperor of Mars and seeks to invade earth and turn in inhabitants into zombie slaves. Lying Finger Cross: When Morg tells Grim he's better than the other Grim Reapers on other planets and would never end up like them, he crosses his fingers behind his back.

characters.name: Thromnambular
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Affably Evil: He’s surprisingly polite for aJackass Genie. Break Them by Talking: Goads many of the wishers by mentioning their deepest desires. Complete Immortality: Appears to have this. He doesn't really get affected from any of the attacks he gets. Evil Sounds Deep: Speaks in a low-tone and only shouts when he has to. He's also evil and aJackass Genie. Exact Words: He relishes on this. Naturally, everyone who got a wish are killed or badly injured. The exception is Junior, who was actually very cautious in what he wanted and got out unscathed despite getting nothing.

characters.name: Pinface
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Childhood Friends: With Grim. Expy:Take two guesses. Laughably Evil: He’s not much of a threat and his screentime is basically screaming at others. Minion with an F in Evil: Not him, but his own minions aren’t the sharpest tools in the shed. Near-Villain Victory: Almost had Billy and Mandy in danger had it not been for Harold messing with the box.

characters.name: Chocolate Sailor
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: As his name suggests, a sailor made of chocolate that gets Billy to turn into chocolate himself. Affably Evil: He’s remarkably cheerful and even has no problem trying to help Billy return to normal, though only after Billy started trying to take bites out him. Creepy High-Pitched Voice: Speaks in a high pitched voice. Quite unusual forRobin Atkin Downes. Living Drawing: First appears as this when he talks to Billy in the comic book the latter was gifted. Pragmatic Villainy: He's annoyed whenever his subordinates eat themselves and is even implied to have a rule against it on his ship, because how can he have a proper crew if they keep eating themselves?

characters.name: Thud
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Eris’ assistant during her scam as a Cereal CEO. The Ditz: He's not very bright and has a bad habit of breaking Eris' rules. He struggles to give a description about Grim and Mandy, simply saying one is short and the other is wearing a robe. Expy: He's pretty muchPatrick Starin all but name and appearance. Kindhearted Simpleton: He's barely even evil and treats just about everyone with courtesy. Minion with an F in Evil: He works for Eris who runs a cereal company that secretly packs phoenix eggs into the boxes as "prizes" to cause chaos but he seems care about their workers, protesting that the elves were growing hungry after Eris demands they double production and is genuinely polite towards Grim, Billy, and Mandy at the reception, albeit largely unhelpful due to his stupidity.

characters.name: King Beardbottom
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: The head of the dwarves who harvest mushrooms in the Mines of Boring-Ya. He drags Billy into the middle of the dwarves' war against the elves. The Comically Serious: In spades. He acts like the elves tricking him out of the cookie-making franchise (admittedly a very lucrative job) is the equivalent of something worse. It certainly helps that he's voiced byMichael Dorn. The Ditz: It's pretty clear he's not bright when evenBillypoints out the holes in his logic. Pretentious Pronunciation: Calls Billy a "hewmon". May double as aShout-OuttoStar Trek: Deep Space Nineas this is also how Quark says human. Amusingly enough, it's Skarr who’s voiced byArmin Shimerman.

characters.name: Cthulhu
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: One of the mightiest of the Great Old Ones, a race of utterly alien and unknowable beings who dominated Earth millions of years before the rise of humanity. He runs a prank-calling operation that mutates people into hideous monsters. Accidental Misnaming: Irwin and Billy keep getting his name wrong, at least until they meet the big man himself.Irwin:I dunno, Billy. This Kahlua guy might not like us using his phone.Billy:First of all, Irwin, it's not Kahlua, it's Cacadidju. Adaptational Dye-Job: For no obvious reason, this version of Cthulhu is purple instead of the usual reptilian green. Adaptational Wimp: In the original stories byH. P. Lovecraft, and in basically every other portrayal to date, Cthulhu is depicted as a gigantic, nigh-unstoppableEldritch Abomination. Anyone who so much as looks at him is driven mad, he can devour people whole and send out hideous nightmares via telepathy, andhe's only temporarily inconvenienced by a steamship ramming into and splitting his skull open. In "Prank Call of Cthulhu", he seems to prefer running a prank-calling operation and playing golf to destroying the world, though he does retain his ability to drive people insane and still has sinister designs on Earth as his prank calls turn humans into tentacled freaks like him. Artifact of Doom: His phone. If it's ever used, it will awaken him and he will destroy the universe. Naturally, Billy uses it to try and make prank calls, then he hires Billy and Irwin to make prank calls that turn people into tentacled freaks.

characters.name: (Pan)Dora
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: A mysterious new student that keeps trying to get people to open her lunch box and hits it off with Mandy. In truth, she's actuallyPandora of Greek mythand is seeking to trick someone to open her lunchbox so she can unleash the evils of the world and get revenge on the gods that cursed her. Birds of a Feather: She shares Mandy's hatred for the world and desire to bring suffering upon humanity so much that Mandy genuinely comes to see her as a friend. The feeling is shared on Pandora's part, and she genuinely believes that Mandy would appreciate being able to unleash the box's power... manipulation notwithstanding. Bullying a Dragon: She really couldn't have picked a worse person to manipulate thanMandy. Commonality Connection: She and Mandy legitimately bond over their deadpan and joyless attitudes whilst causing mayhem and destruction. That being said, Pandora takes more open joy while Mandy is just along for the ride... though is obviously enjoying said chaos all the while. Corrupted Character Copy: She resemblesDora the Explorerin appearance and shares her name while posing as a normal human... but given theshow she's in, it's no surprise that Pandora's resemblance to Dora is only skin-deep (and for the sake of thePun). She is evil, vindicative, cruel,and is Greek rather than Latina.

characters.name: Billy's Nose
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Billy'sGag Nosethat suddenly comes to life and leaves his face. Does This Remind You of Anything?: The way it leaves Billy is similar to that of a cheating spouse. Gag Nose: It's Billy's nose after all. Minor Major Character: In a sense. While it's a noticeable part of Billy, it only came to life once.

characters.name: Poppen Lockin
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: Irwin's maternal grandfather. Affably Evil: He's pretty cool, but he's not a good person in the slightest. Dirty Coward: When using Irwin to cast his spell he assures that nothing bad will happen to him, but he will be away to not risk himself. Evil Counterpart: To Dracula,Irwin's paternal grandfather. Whereas Dracula is fairly mellow when not being rude, Poppen Lockin is affable, but very much willing to destroy people. Gruesome Grandparent: Merely used his grandson as a tool for world domination.

characters.name: Tooth Fairy
characters.media_title: Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The
characters.description: The very one from legend. Beethoven Was an Alien Spy: Or a cowboy. The Dreaded: Grim panics when he reveals his Gold Star Scepter, telling Mandy that the power of the Scythe is nothing compared to it. Food-Based Superpowers: His Gold Star Scepter has the power to turn people into or conjure fast food. He can only do the former if someone believes in his existence. Graceful Loser: After Mandy thwarts his plans, he decides to cut his losses anduse his food conjuring abilities to open a chain of fast food restaurants.
